name: The Secret Ingredient
source:
Eric is slowly losing his sense of taste after years of exposure to cafeteria food. Perhaps what he needed all along was a bit of magic.

[From [url=http://teacup.lunaen.com/index.php?topic=42.0]Official site[/url]]
translation:
多年食用食堂饭菜后，埃里克的味觉正在逐渐消失。或许他一直以来所需要的，只是一点魔法。

[摘自[url=http://teacup.lunaen.com/index.php?topic=42.0]官方网站[/url]]
